SMTO-TSK-0062 — The task you chose to wait for isn't in this conversation

GUID: fe1d476b-18ce-4711-8f23-d22de57bb7a4
Slug: task-dependency-target-missing
Domain: TSK · Subsystem: tsk

What happened

  • Your message was set to run only after another task, but SMTO can't find that task in this conversation. It may have been deleted. Your message wasn't queued.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the SMTO page so the list of tasks in this conversation is up to date. The task you picked may have been deleted or finished since the list was loaded.
  2. Open Depends on next to the message box and choose a task from the list, or choose No dependency — run independently. SMTO can only wait for a task that still exists in this same conversation.
  3. Send your message again. Your earlier message was not queued, so sending it again won't create a duplicate.

What success looks like

  • Your message appears as a task, showing Run After with the task you chose, or running on its own.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't choose a task from a different conversation; SMTO only allows waiting on tasks in the same one.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Task dependency registration failed: the explicit depends_on target task does not exist (DEPENDENCY_TARGET_MISSING), or depends_on_previous was requested but the conversation has no earlier task (DEPENDENCY_PREVIOUS_TASK_NOT_FOUND).

What this means

  • An explicit dependency target is absent, or depends_on_previous has no prior task in the same conversation. Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.

Why this can happen

  • An explicit dependency target is absent, or depends_on_previous has no prior task in the same conversation.

How to diagnose it

  • Check exact target identity and creation order; no previous task is different from a task that merely has not finished.

How to fix it

  • Re-read the conversation's task lane and submit with a depends_on_task_id that exists in the same conversation, or omit the dependency (and depends_on_previous) to submit independently. Do not resubmit a stale task identifier.
  • Choose an existing task in this conversation or submit independently if no dependency is intended.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended existing same-conversation dependency is selected, or independent work is explicitly chosen.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Task state and retained ownership decide whether an action is eligible. Diagnostics do not change lane order, consent, snapshots, cancellation or execution; preserve original receipts and reconcile any possible effects before new work.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
